name: Cairo and Sharm El Sheikh Honeymoon Package
description: Get the chance to scout all the gleaming landmarks of Egypt Honeymoon, because first days in married should be memorable, with Cairo and Sharm El Sheikh Honeymoon Packages achieve your dream for unforgettable moments while you explore the underwater world at the Red Sea, stare at the amazement of Pyramids and more Honeymoon in Egypt.

highlights: Day at Leisure in Sharm El Sheikh

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, at the end of your day tour back to your hotel, Optional for Dinner Cruise on the magic Nile River with Belly Dancer. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Pharaonic Village Wedding Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to the Pharaonic Village, upon arrival you will be welcomed by Zaffa, ( Egyptian music and Egyptian Band ), watch folklore show, it is a new experience to feel the Egyptian Wedding while listening to the oriental music, then you will enjoy a unforgettable round to the Pharaonic Village to scout the Pharaonic life, finally at the end of your special wedding day, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Arrive Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo domestic airport, catch your flight to Sharm, meet & assist at Sharm airport, transfer to hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Sharm El Sheikh, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling, optional to try Desert Safari at the heart of Sinai Desert from Sharm. Overnight in Sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Sharm El Sheikh, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling, optional to try Desert Safari at the heart of Sinai Desert from Sharm. Overnight in Sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Day 06: Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Sharm airport, catch your flight back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned Vehicle
Four Nights accommodation in Cairo including Breakfast and all taxes
Two Nights accommodation in Sharm including Breakfast and all taxes
One day tour in Cairo as mentioned at the above itinerary
One day Wedding excursion at the Pharaonic Village in Cairo to celebrate your wedding with Egyptian band and Egyptian Music
One Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo
A Bottle of Mineral Water to each person
English speaking guide at Cairo sightseeing tours
Entrance fees to the sites as mentioned at the above itinerary
Transfers in Cairo and Sharm by air-conditioned vehicle
Transfer to Cairo International airport for final departure.
exclusions: Supplement cost for the Grand Egyptian Museum instead of the Old Egyptian Museum: USD 25 per person
Entrance inside any of the pyramids will be with extra fees (Tickets can be booked on the Spot) -1st Great Pyramids: 35.00 USD$ - 2nd Pyramids OR 3rd Pyramid: 15.00 USD$
Optional tours not mentioned at the above itinerary.
